stem.text: Sibirene, $\text{C}_{15}\text{H}_{24}$, is reacted with an excess of $\text{HBr(g)}$. The major product is **X**.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: sibirene (bicyclic ring compound with an isopropyl group, a methyl group and an exocyclic C=CH2) reacts with excess HBr(g) to give the major product X

stem.text: What is the skeletal formula of **X**?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: bicyclic ring with isopropyl group, methyl at ring fusion, Br on a ring carbon and Br on a CH2 group

B.alt: Skeletal formula: bicyclic ring with isopropyl group, methyl at ring fusion, Br on the ring carbon bearing the isopropyl group and Br on a CH2 group

C.alt: Skeletal formula: bicyclic ring with isopropyl group, methyl at ring fusion, Br on a ring carbon and Br on a carbon bearing a methyl group

D.alt: Skeletal formula: bicyclic ring with isopropyl group, methyl at ring fusion, Br on the ring carbon bearing the isopropyl group and Br on a carbon bearing a methyl group
